title: Senior AI Platform Engineer
summary: Own the AI screening platform used by enterprise recruiters. Build resilient APIs, ranking models, analytics, and developer workflows.
requirements: 5+ years of experience building backend or machine learning products.
Strong Python, FastAPI, SQL, Docker, and PostgreSQL experience.
Hands-on NLP, scikit-learn, spaCy, or semantic search experience.
Experience deploying cloud services on AWS and collaborating with frontend teams using React and TypeScript.
responsibilities: Design candidate ranking services, ATS scoring pipelines, and recruiter analytics APIs.
Partner with product, design, and recruiting stakeholders to improve hiring workflows.
Own observability, documentation, testing, and deployment for the screening stack.

title: Recruiter Analytics Frontend Lead
summary: Build the flagship recruiter cockpit for analytics, reporting, and candidate review workflows across enterprise hiring teams.
requirements: 6+ years of frontend engineering experience with React and TypeScript.
Deep experience with TailwindCSS, enterprise dashboard design, and charting libraries such as Recharts.
Comfort collaborating with backend teams, product designers, and end users in a fast moving environment.
responsibilities: Lead architecture for recruiter dashboards, theming, and interaction design systems.
Translate hiring analytics into actionable charts, filters, and drill-down experiences.
Coach other engineers and keep accessibility, performance, and responsiveness at a high bar.
